rics.how_to_use: China's banking system is dominated by 6 state-owned commercial banks (the 'Big 6': ICBC, CCB, ABC, BoC, BoCom, PSBC) plus joint-stock banks, city commercial banks, and rural commercial banks. PBoC regulates prudentially via CAR, NPL, LCR, NSFR ratios.
